title: Cohort Hiring Pilot — PM Rotation & Shadow Lab Notes
content:
Purpose and scope:
- Run a 6-week cohort pilot to hire 6 mid-level Product Managers (IC3/PM2 equivalent) via a rotational + shadow-lab funnel. Goal: reduce time-to-productivity and improve cross-functional evaluation signals.
- Focus metrics: hire velocity (target 6 hires in 8 weeks), first-30-day impact score, ramp time (time to independent sprint lead), & hiring quality (offer-to-accept conversion + peer-probation pass).

High level flow (candidate experience):
1) Screening (resume + short take-home 2-hour exercise) — move fast, asynchronous feedback within 48 hours.
2) Cohort assessment day (virtual): 3 exercises in parallel pods — product scoping, cross-functional stakeholder roleplay, and rapid data puzzle. Candidates rotate between pods (40m/pod).
3) Shortlist -> onsite/remote shadow-lab week: 3-day immersion inside a working pod (pairing with PM buddy, small scoped ticket to own).
4) Cohort demo + hiring council review -> final offers.

Why cohort + shadow lab?
- Observes collaboration, async ops, and stakeholder skills in realistic context rather than purely whiteboard artifacts.
- Efficient recruiter time (evaluate many candidates same week) and stronger peer signal (multiple PMs see same behavior).

Interview / assessment rubric (scoring template) — single-line guidance per competency, score 1–4 (1=unacceptable, 4=strong):
- Product sense (weight 25%): defines user, selects high-leverage constraint, prioritizes tradeoffs.
- Execution & delivery (weight 20%): breaks down work into deliverables, estimates, communicates dependencies, ships a small ticket in the lab.
- Cross-functional influence (weight 20%): runs stakeholder syncs, surfaces tradeoffs, negotiates scope.
- Data literacy (weight 15%): asks for relevant metrics, proposes simple experiments, interprets signals.
- Communication clarity (weight 10%): synthesizes decisions, writes clear PRDs or brief notes.
- Growth mindset & ramp signals (weight 10%): learns quickly, seeks feedback, can operate without full context.

Pass thresholds (pilot-specific):
- Minimum weighted aggregate = 2.8/4 to be considered; at least one 3+ in product sense OR cross-functional influence.
- Panel override allowed only with 3 independent raters agreeing.

Shadow-lab weekly activation checklist (for candidates during 3-day immersion):
- Day 0 (pre-lab) 
  - Slack intro to pod (people-ops to send template) — confirm calendar, workspace access, and key docs.
  - Candidate short bio + 3 expectations items posted to #cohort-shadow channel.
- Day 1 
  - Pair with assigned PM buddy, join daily stand, observe backlog grooming.
  - Deliverable: scope a tiny experiment (one paragraph, success metric).
  - Feedback checkpoint EOD: 15-min sync with PM buddy (notes captured).
- Day 2 
  - Own 1 small ticket: write acceptance criteria, QA guidelines, and coordinate a short demo.
  - Run a 20-min stakeholder sync roleplay with Eng + Design (scripted).
- Day 3 
  - Demo + retrospective: 10-min demo, 10-min retro with panel.
  - Candidate reflections: 3 learning bullets + 1 ask for support.

Hiring council composition & timing:
- 1 product lead (not direct manager), 1 engineering partner, 1 design lead, 1 peer PM, 1 people-ops rep.
- Council meets twice weekly during demo weeks; decisions are timeboxed to 72 hours post-demo.

Evaluation artifacts to collect (minimal):
- Completed rubric from each rater (named), candidate one-pager summary (template included below), shadow-lab ticket + link to PR/notes, candidate self-reflection.

Candidate one-pager template (one paragraph each section):
- Background + core impact, top 2 strengths for Redwood, top 2 risk signals, recommended role fit and ramp plan (30/60/90).

Onboarding micro-plan for hires (first 30 days) — activation-focused, to be handed to manager at offer acceptance:
- Week 0 (pre-start): account provisioning, 1:1 intro schedule set, first-week sprint goals agreed, reading list (product docs + Infra/RPO checklist).
- Week 1: paired tickets, join weekly roadmap sync, 30-min daily check-ins with PM buddy. Deliverable: ship scoped experiment with clear metrics.
- Week 2: start owning a small customer-facing story, run a retro with stakeholders. Deliverable: draft 30/60/90 plan.
- Weeks 3–4: increase stakeholder ownership, co-lead the sprint planning, present learning to pod.

Success signals to track (manager + people-ops):
- Week 2: shipped ticket + documented learnings (yes/no).
- Week 4: stakeholder satisfaction survey (avg >=3/5 targeted).
- Day 30: manager assessment vs ramp plan (on-track/behind).
- Day 90: independent sprint lead capability (qualitative + simple rubric).

Operational notes and TODOs:
- Recruiters: build cohort job post copy emphasizing "shadow-lab" and real-scope deliverables — draft in /recruiting/templates. TODO: Jonah to draft by 2025-08-20.
- Hiring panel training: run a 30-min calibration session (score normalization) before demo week. TODO: Lina to schedule.
- Slack channels: create #cohort-shadow-aug2025 and #cohort-hiring-feedback. People-ops to manage moderation.
- Data capture: create a simple GA sheet to track rubric scores, offers, rejections, and feedback tags. TODO: Sofia to prototype.

Open questions / risks:
- Candidate capacity: will market accept multi-step cohort funnel vs standard interviews? need A/B with small pipeline.
- Manager time: shadow-lab requires dedicated PM buddies — what incentives/rotation for mentors? propose a 1:1 adjustment in workload for mentors during pilot.
- Legal / compensation: short immersion requires clear NDAs and expense policy (people-ops to confirm with legal).

Appendix — quick scoring cheat-sheet for raters (sticky notes style):
- If you see ambiguity on metrics: ask candidate to name 1 metric they would track first. If they cannot — score 2 or below on Data literacy.
- If candidate shipped something in lab: add +0.25 to Execution score as tie-breaker.
- If candidate avoids stakeholder conflict: subtract -0.25 on Cross-functional influence.

Meeting notes snapshot (working):
- 2025-08-14 design sync: agree to run pilot across two pods (growth & infra).
- 2025-08-20 recruiter playbook due.
- 2025-08-28 calibration run with internal volunteers (mock candidates).

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Keep docs minimal and operational. Avoid heavy PRD — this is a working experiment.
- We want repeatable artifacts for future cohorts (templates + rubric).
- Capture candidate quotes post-lab for NPS-style feedback.
